  Description string
  Parameters string

  Milli int64

  MaxOutput int64
  Temperature *Temperature

  Model string
  Messages []Message

  RequiredExtensions []string

type Chat interface

type Operator interface
  Hosts() (HostList, error)
  AddHost(expectedRevision string, host HostEntry) (HostChange, error)
  RemoveHost(expectedRevision, name string) (HostChange, error)
  Keys() (KeyList, error)
  IssueKey(program, credential string) (KeyIssued, error)
  RevokeKey(program string) (KeyRevoked, error)
  Audit(cursor, maxEntries int64) (AuditPage, error)
  Gateway() (GatewayState, error)
  SetGateway(expectedRevision string, open bool, address string) (GatewayChange, error)
type OperatorTransport interface
  FrameExchanger
type OperatorClient struct
func NewOperatorClient(t OperatorTransport) *OperatorClient
type OperatorDispatcher struct
  Handler Operator
func (OperatorClient) Hosts() (result HostList, err error)
func (OperatorClient) AddHost(expectedRevision string, host HostEntry) (result HostChange, err error)
func (OperatorClient) RemoveHost(expectedRevision, name string) (result HostChange, err error)
func (OperatorClient) Keys() (result KeyList, err error)
func (OperatorClient) IssueKey(program, credential string) (result KeyIssued, err error)
func (OperatorClient) RevokeKey(program string) (result KeyRevoked, err error)
func (OperatorClient) Audit(cursor, maxEntries int64) (result AuditPage, err error)
func (OperatorClient) Gateway() (result GatewayState, err error)
func (OperatorClient) SetGateway(expectedRevision string, open bool, address string) (result GatewayChange, err error)
func (OperatorDispatcher) DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func (OperatorDispatcher) ServiceContract() string
func (OperatorDispatcher) WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
func (OperatorDispatcher) ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
